speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Education (a) whether the number of lactation rooms in autonomous universities, polytechnics and the Institutes of Technical Education campuses are based on the size of the campuses; and (b) if so, what is the average area of the campus in square metres that is served by one lactation room.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: One, what is the average number of lactation rooms, in terms of per university, per polytechnic and ITE, respectively?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Second, I think that there really is a time concern when it comes to the teachers because unlike other workers, they cannot pump while they are teaching.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: So, there is a request for more lactation rooms because they really cannot queue for these facilities.

speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
text: For example, some of our IHL campuses have very large sporting facilities.
